intro: A mid-level engineer who leads with what their code changed for the business, not a list of technologies. Each job shows scale, ownership and a result.
tips: Lead each job with the result you'd most want to discuss in an interview.
Name the systems and their scale: requests, users, data, money.
Group skills by kind, using the words job posts use.

basics.name: Priya Raman
basics.label: Software Engineer, Backend
basics.summary: Backend engineer with six years building payment and billing systems in Go and TypeScript. Moved a monolith's billing to event-driven services handling 3 million invoices a month. Looking for a senior role on a platform team.

work.name: Northwind Payments
work.summary: Billing and invoicing platform for 40,000 small businesses.
highlights: Split billing out of the monolith into four Go services; invoice runs went from 6 hours to 40 minutes.
Designed idempotent retries for card payments, cutting duplicate charges to zero over 18 months.
Mentored three graduate engineers; two now own services of their own.
On call for payments; wrote the runbooks the team uses for its five most common incidents.

work.name: Lumen Health
highlights: Built the booking API in Node.js and PostgreSQL that took 1.2 million bookings a year.
Cut page load on the patient booking flow from 4.1s to 1.3s by caching clinic availability.
